rule: tolerance = max(budget_pct/100 x |reference| (for temperatures: x the rise above ambient), 2 x the reference's uncertainty); a case passes when every compared value lies within its tolerance; a quantity passes when at least 80 % of its cases pass and no case misses by more than twice its tolerance
